mcqs.question: What was the installed solar capacity of Andhra Pradesh in September 2025?
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Pradesh had an installed solar capacity of 5,006 MW in September 2025. The figures 78.50 GWp and 130 MW refer to the policy target and rooftop projects for government buildings, respectively; 2,138 KW refers to rooftop solar in model schools and KGBVs.

mcqs.question: What was the value of the APTRANSCO power works announced in Andhra Pradesh in September 2025?
mcqs.explanation: APTRANSCO works worth ₹5,500 crore were announced at 68 locations. The tempting figure 68 refers to the number of locations, not the value of the works; the other amounts are not the announced project value.
